brace.name: Seated 360° abdominal brace
brace.setup: Sit on a stable, locked bench with back support if needed and the injured casted leg comfortably supported, not pushing into the floor.
brace.cue: Breathe out slowly. Gently firm your midsection without holding your breath, moving the cast or tensing into pain. Reset between gentle contractions.

palms.name: Seated palms-together midline press
palms.setup: Sit upright on the bench with the cast supported. Place palms lightly together at chest height; stay in a comfortable shoulder range.
palms.cue: Press your palms together lightly while keeping ribs stacked over hips. Exhale softly without leaning or leg bracing. Release as needed.

rotation.name: Seated small-range torso turns
rotation.setup: Sit tall with supported back and injured leg stable. Cross arms loosely over chest; move only if your clinician specifically cleared trunk rotation.
rotation.cue: Gently turn your upper body a small comfortable distance, return to center, then alternate. Do not twist through your cast or push with either foot.
rotation.limit: No weights · small range · skip if spine/hip/leg symptoms

reach.name: Bench-supported alternating forward reach
reach.setup: Sit upright with the bench back supporting you and the leg supported. Keep both arms near torso before each reach.
reach.cue: Reach one hand a short comfortable distance forward and return without leaning or pushing with the injured foot. Alternate slowly.
reach.limit: Unloaded · controlled range · shoulder clearance required

pallofL.name: Seated Pallof hold · band pulling from left
pallofL.setup: Secure a very light resistance band to a stable chest-height rack anchor to your LEFT side, away from the cast. Sit on a locked bench with the leg supported; no band behind the neck or around the cast.
pallofL.cue: Hold the band at your chest or gently press forward within your shoulder clearance. Keep torso facing straight ahead and breathe. Do not push your foot into the floor.
pallofL.limit: Optional very light resistance · stable chest-height rack anchor

pallofR.name: Seated Pallof hold · band pulling from right
pallofR.setup: Move the very light band to a stable chest-height rack anchor on your RIGHT side, far from the injured cast. Keep bench stable and cast independently supported.
pallofR.cue: Maintain a tall neutral torso without twisting toward the band. Exhale as you hold or press gently in your cleared range; no leg bracing.
pallofR.limit: Optional very light resistance · independent cast support

offsetL.name: Seated offset dumbbell hold · left hand
offsetL.setup: On a locked bench with supported cast and torso, hold one clinician-cleared light dumbbell in your LEFT hand at your side. Keep neck and shoulders relaxed.
offsetL.cue: Stay upright against the gentle side pull without leaning or holding your breath. Set weight down safely if shoulder, grip or leg pressure develops.
offsetL.limit: Clinician-cleared light load only · no leaning

offsetR.name: Seated offset dumbbell hold · right hand
offsetR.setup: On a locked bench with supported cast, hold one clinician-cleared light dumbbell in your RIGHT hand at your side. Do not prop it against your leg.
offsetR.cue: Maintain upright ribs over hips. Keep the cast relaxed and supported; do not lean, sway or brace with the injured foot.
offsetR.limit: Clinician-cleared light load only · no leaning

foundation.label: Core A · Bench foundation
foundation.info: Four unloaded movements emphasizing gentle bracing, posture and controlled upper-body motion.

resistance.label: Core B · Anti-rotation
resistance.info: A bench-based core circuit using very light, clinician-cleared resistance. Requires a stable chest-height band anchor and an appropriately light dumbbell.
